==============================================================
  ValidDs Backend — API Keys & Account Setup Guide
==============================================================

This file explains how to create accounts and obtain all the
API keys and credentials needed to run this project.

Once you have each key, add it to your .env file.
NEVER commit your .env file to version control.

--------------------------------------------------------------
INDEX
--------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Sentry (Error Monitoring)
2.  Grafana Cloud / Prometheus (Metrics)
3.  EnsembleData (TikTok Data Ingestion)
4.  DeepSeek (AI / LLM)
5.  TikTok for Developers (OAuth Login)
6.  RapidAPI — Lundehund / tiktok-creative-center-api (Creative Center Data)


==============================================================
1. SENTRY — Error Monitoring
==============================================================
URL: https://sentry.io
Need an account: YES (free tier is sufficient)

What you get:
  SENTRY_DSN=https://xxx@oYYY.ingest.sentry.io/ZZZZZ

Steps:
  1. Go to https://sentry.io and click "Get Started"
  2. Sign up with GitHub or email
  3. Create an Organisation (e.g. "validds" or your team name)
  4. Click "Projects" in the sidebar → "Create Project"
  5. Select "Node.js" as the platform
  6. Name the project "validds-backend" → click "Create Project"
  7. Sentry will show you a DSN immediately after creation.
     It looks like:
       https://abc123@o987654.ingest.sentry.io/1234567
  8. If you lose it later:
     Settings → Projects → validds-backend → Client Keys (DSN)

Add to .env:
  SENTRY_DSN=<your DSN here>
  SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=development
  SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1

Notes:
  - Free tier gives 5,000 errors/month — plenty for V1
  - Leave SENTRY_DSN empty locally to avoid dev noise
  - Use "development", "staging", "production" per environment


==============================================================
2. GRAFANA CLOUD / PROMETHEUS — Metrics & Dashboards
==============================================================
URL: https://grafana.com/auth/sign-up
Need an account: YES (free tier is sufficient)
Note: Prometheus is NOT a separate account — Grafana Cloud
      hosts Prometheus for you. No self-hosted setup needed.

What you get:
  METRICS_ENABLED=true
  METRICS_PORT=9090
  (Optional: PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE_URL, PROMETHEUS_USERNAME,
   PROMETHEUS_API_KEY — only needed for cloud push mode)

Steps:
  1. Go to https://grafana.com/auth/sign-up
  2. Sign up with GitHub or email
  3. Create a "Stack" (your Grafana Cloud workspace)
     - Name it "validds" or similar
     - Choose the region closest to your deployment
  4. In your stack, go to:
     Connections → Add new connection → "Hosted Prometheus metrics"
  5. Follow the setup wizard — at the end you will receive:
     - PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE_URL
     - PROMETHEUS_USERNAME (numeric ID)
     - PROMETHEUS_API_KEY (starts with "glc_")
  6. To view dashboards:
     - Go to Dashboards → Import
     - Import dashboard ID 1860 (standard Node.js dashboard)
     - Select your Prometheus data source

Add to .env:
  METRICS_ENABLED=true
  METRICS_PORT=9090

Optional (for cloud push mode):
  PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE_URL=https://prometheus-xxx.grafana.net/api/prom/push
  PROMETHEUS_USERNAME=123456
  PROMETHEUS_API_KEY=glc_xxxxx

Notes:
  - Free tier: 10,000 active metric series, 14-day retention
  - The app exposes /metrics on METRICS_PORT for scraping
  - Set METRICS_ENABLED=false in tests to avoid port conflicts


==============================================================
3. ENSEMBLEDATA — TikTok Data Ingestion
==============================================================
URL: https://www.ensembledata.com
Need an account: YES (pay-per-use, free trial available)

What you get:
  ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN=<your token>

Steps:
  1. Go to https://www.ensembledata.com
  2. Click "Get Started" or "Sign Up"
  3. Register with your email and create a password
  4. Verify your email address
  5. Log in to your Dashboard
  6. Your API token is displayed on the Dashboard home page
     (It will also appear in your profile/account settings)
  7. Copy the token — it authenticates all API requests

Add to .env:
  ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN=<your token here>

Notes:
  - Pricing is pay-per-use based on "units" consumed per request
  - Check https://www.ensembledata.com/pricing for current rates
  - The token goes in the Authorization header as a Bearer token
  - This project uses EnsembleData for:
      - TikTok keyword/hashtag search
      - TikTok trending post data
  - The current 404 errors are because the token is missing or
    the endpoint paths need confirming in your dashboard

Troubleshooting 404 errors:
  - Confirm your token is active and has units/credits
  - Check https://www.ensembledata.com/api-status for outages
  - Review the endpoint paths at https://www.ensembledata.com/apis
    to ensure the URLs in src/ingestion/ensemble/ensemble.client.ts
    match what your subscription plan provides


==============================================================
4. DEEPSEEK — AI / Large Language Model
==============================================================
URL: https://platform.deepseek.com
Need an account: YES (pay-per-use, cheap rates)

What you get:
  DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Steps:
  1. Go to https://platform.deepseek.com
  2. Click "Sign Up" — register with email or phone
  3. Verify your account (email/phone confirmation)
  4. Log in to your dashboard
  5. In the left sidebar, click "API Keys"
  6. Click "Create new secret key"
  7. Give it a name (e.g. "validds-backend")
  8. Copy the key immediately — it is only shown once
     Store it securely (password manager, .env file)
  9. Add credit to your account before use:
     Billing → Top Up Balance

Add to .env:
  DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Notes:
  - The DeepSeek API is OpenAI-compatible
    (base URL: https://api.deepseek.com)
  - You must top up your balance before API calls will work
  - Rates are significantly cheaper than OpenAI GPT-4
  - This project uses DeepSeek for AI product analysis/extraction


==============================================================
5. TIKTOK FOR DEVELOPERS — OAuth Login (Client Key & Secret)
==============================================================
URL: https://developers.tiktok.com
Need an account: YES (requires a TikTok account)

What you get:
  TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=aw1234567890abcdef
  TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET=abc123def456ghi789jkl012mno345

Steps:
  1. Go to https://developers.tiktok.com
  2. Log in with your TikTok account (or create one)
  3. Accept the TikTok Developer Terms and Conditions
  4. Click "Manage Apps" in the top navigation
  5. Click "Connect an app" → "Create new app"
  6. Fill in the required details:
     - App Name: e.g., "ValidDs"
     - App Description: brief description of your platform
     - App Category: select "Business"
     - App Icon: upload a logo image
     - Platform: select "Web"
     - Website URL: your live app URL (or localhost for dev)
  7. In the side panel, click "Products" → "+ Add products"
     Add: "Login Kit" (for OAuth authentication)
  8. Under Login Kit, register your Redirect URI:
     For local:   http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/tiktok/callback
     For staging: https://your-app.onrender.com/api/v1/auth/tiktok/callback
     (Must be HTTPS for production; can be HTTP for localhost)
  9. Go back to your app's main page — you will see:
     - Client Key (also called App Key / client_id)
     - Client Secret (click to reveal)
  10. Copy both values

Add to .env:
  TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=<your client key>
  TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET=<your client secret>

Notes:
  - Keep Client Secret on the server only — never in the frontend
  - TikTok may require app review for production use
  - During development, sandbox mode allows testing without review
  - The redirect URI must exactly match what is registered in the portal


==============================================================
6. RAPIDAPI — Lundehund / TikTok Creative Center API
==============================================================
URL: https://rapidapi.com
API Page: https://rapidapi.com/Lundehund/api/tiktok-creative-center-api
Need an account: YES (free basic plan available)

What you get:
  RAPIDAPI_KEY=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
  RAPIDAPI_HOST=tiktok-creative-center-api.p.rapidapi.com
  RAPIDAPI_BASE_URL=https://tiktok-creative-center-api.p.rapidapi.com

Steps:
  1. Go to https://rapidapi.com and click "Sign Up"
     Register with email, GitHub, or Google
  2. Once logged in, go to the API page:
     https://rapidapi.com/Lundehund/api/tiktok-creative-center-api
  3. Click the "Pricing" tab — review available plans
     (The "Basic" / free tier allows limited requests per month)
  4. Click "Subscribe" on your chosen plan
  5. Your API key is auto-generated upon subscription.
     To find it:
     - Go to the API's "Endpoints" tab
     - In the Code Snippet panel, look for "X-RapidAPI-Key" in the headers
     - OR go to your Developer Dashboard → Apps → your app → API Key
  6. Note the host from the header: "X-RapidAPI-Host"
     It will be: tiktok-creative-center-api.p.rapidapi.com

Add to .env:
  RAPIDAPI_KEY=<your X-RapidAPI-Key here>
  RAPIDAPI_HOST=tiktok-creative-center-api.p.rapidapi.com
  RAPIDAPI_BASE_URL=https://tiktok-creative-center-api.p.rapidapi.com
  RAPIDAPI_TOP_ADS_PATH=/api/1/keyword/top_ads
  RAPIDAPI_TRENDING_HASHTAGS_PATH=/api/1/hashtag/trend
  RAPIDAPI_TRENDING_VIDEOS_PATH=/api/1/item/search
  RAPIDAPI_KEYWORD_TRENDS_PATH=/api/1/keyword/trend
  CREATIVE_CENTER_REGION=US

Notes:
  - This is the primary fallback when EnsembleData fails
  - The X-RapidAPI-Key is the same across ALL RapidAPI subscriptions
    (one key, multiple APIs — tied to your RapidAPI account)
  - Check the exact endpoint paths in the API docs on RapidAPI
    as they may vary from the defaults above
  - Free plans have monthly request limits — upgrade if needed


==============================================================
SUMMARY — All .env keys to fill in
==============================================================

# Sentry
SENTRY_DSN=
SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=development
SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1

# Grafana / Prometheus
METRICS_ENABLED=true
METRICS_PORT=9090

# EnsembleData
ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN=

# DeepSeek
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=


# RapidAPI (TikTok Creative Center)
RAPIDAPI_KEY=
